title: P8 Soak Integration
objective: Integrate four-platform numerical soak authentication, release workflow fixtures, and bounded scheduled execution

handoff.summary: Authenticated the four platform-local numerical soak categories and their exact paths/schema, updated the release-gate fixture to six requirements and eleven raw supplemental records, and added a Wednesday scheduled/manual Linux x64 campaign. The scheduled job builds source-current numerical Wasm, runs only the bounded scheduled profile, cancels superseded runs, has a 120-minute hard timeout, preserves diagnostics, and has no push or pull-request trigger.
risks: RELEASE.md is not an allowed claim in any registered parallel lane, so root explicitly retained that edit instead of widening the lane registry.

The integration lane's broad architecture/portable/strict checks were not repeated for this three-file wiring patch; focused authentication, release-workflow, soak-evidence, merge-invariant, and syntax checks pass.
next_steps: In RELEASE.md near the platform collector description, state that it also writes <platform>-soak.evidence.json using the release profile and that all four are mandatory. Change the gate inventory paragraph from five requirements/seven records to six requirements/eleven records, naming four-platform soak evidence. Change the tag publication prerequisite near line 272 from all five supplemental gates to all six.
After cherry-picking, run the repository-wide integration checks once alongside the other P8 lanes rather than rebuilding independently for this wiring-only patch.
